_about: Test vectors generated by accelverify/compare.py from reference implementations written from the driver sources (yeetmouse fork 0.9.5+dirscale1; RawAccel v1.7.1). multiplier = f(speed); speed in counts/ms as seen by the curve (fork: after DirScale*PreScale, Offset=0, InputCap=0; RawAccel: whole mode, lpNorm 2, DPI 0, weights 1). 'rawaccel_double' and 'fork_real' are exact-arithmetic models (double); 'fork_fixedpoint' is the output of the fork's own C code (Q32.32) run in userspace. Implementers should assert against rawaccel_double with rel. tolerance 1e-9 for a double implementation, and expect the fixed-point column to deviate as documented in REPORT.md.

fork_must_refuse_examples._about: Parameter sets an editor must NOT write to the fork. TRAP = signed 128/64 idivq quotient overflow or division by zero inside update_constants() (SIGFPE in the userspace build of the fork sources; a divide-error exception in the kernel). REJECTED = fork silently switches to mode 0 (no acceleration). Every case is refused by refimpl.editor_violations() (rules R1-R5 and the ranges of REPORT section 7.1); the violated rules are listed per case.

_editor_rules: Each parameter set carries 'editor_allows' and 'editor_rule_violations', computed by refimpl.editor_violations() (REPORT 7.1 ranges = R4; R1 breakpoints <= 1e5; R2 power offset <= 99*scale*exponent; R3 power cap > offset; R5 f_ref(1000) <= 1e5). Sets with editor_allows=false are kept as fixtures for the maths only; an editor must not offer them.
